title: San Diego Fire Chief Reflects on the Integration of the Fire Department
description:
This Black History Month, San Diego's Fire Chief Robert Logan reflects on the trailblazing legacy of Alwin Benjamin Holman.

Before Holman integrated Fire Station 14 in North Park in 1951, all Black firefighters in San Diego were segregated in Fire Station 19 in Mountain View. Holman later became San Diego’s first Black Deputy Fire Chief, serving 32 years.

Chief Logan credits Holman for opening doors that made his own journey possible. 

Recently, the City celebrated Holman’s 100th birthday, declaring Dec. 26, 2025, as Alwin Benjamin Holman Day.
